analyst.economicRationale: Severe retained scenario shows positive EBIT, gross interest cover of 3.65x and stressed operating cash proxy of VND 0.424tn. Stressed FCF is VND -4.674tn and 91.0% of debt is short-term. Negative modeled FCF and refinancing exposure imply material pressure and reliance on buffers or investment and funding adjustments.
analyst.higherBand: Band 3 needs affirmative manageable pressures and meaningful buffers. Deposit and CAPEX sensitivities leave those buffers unestablished.
analyst.lowerBand: Band 1 needs very weak stressed financial capacity and serious dependence on potentially adverse actions. Positive EBIT and stressed interest coverage plus sensitivity to outlay flexibility leave that degree unestablished.

materialPressure.rationale: Stressed FCF is VND -4.674tn and 91.0% of debt is short-term. Negative modeled FCF and refinancing exposure imply material pressure and reliance on buffers or investment and funding adjustments.

economicVulnerability.rationale: Halving modeled working-capital outflow alone leaves FCF at VND -3.359tn. Halving modeled CAPEX alone leaves FCF at VND -2.125tn. Deposit assumptions affect the remaining buffer but do not alter operating FCF. Severe retained scenario shows positive EBIT, gross interest cover of 3.65x and stressed operating cash proxy of VND 0.424tn. Positive interest cover does not absorb a cash deficit and concentrated maturities.
